     loss as congestion.               
                                       
     Implementations also tune         
     initial windows, slow-start       
     thresholds, and recovery via      
     algorithms like NewReno, Vegas,   
     and HyStart. The shared goal      
     remains: fill the network pipe    
     efficiently, share capacity       
     fairly with other flows, and      
     back off when congestion          
     signals appear.
